summary: WP2 ImplementationDesign handoff for docsys-wp-root-readme-reduction. CodingAndReparing is authorized to reduce root README.md into a concise adoption/product entry and router while retaining positioning, problem framing, certainty formula, three core components, high-level delivery flow, quick start/deployment checks, entry selection, and curated next links. Deep semantic operator, MCP, validator, credential, command, and lifecycle detail must be routed to stable design references instead of duplicated inline.
